factor_name: Inverse risk-adjusted medium trend with directional confirmation

calculation.description: Invert a 60-trading-day return normalized by 60-day realized volatility and weighted by the fraction of positive return days over the latest 20 sessions. Cross-sectional ranking is used; the inverse direction is the validated signal. All inputs are lagged completed closes.

validation.regime_notes: Positive inverse-signal IC is effectively neutral in 2020-2024, negative for the original direction in 2025-2029 and strongly negative in 2030 YTD; interpret as a contrarian medium-trend factor with substantial regime dependence and conservative weighting.
